jongny.admission: Only three exact downhill platform pairs in all complete route contexts. Ten connected source ways must appear in the same order in all three exact j26 bus route relations. Preserve directions, source stop identities and calls; no intersecting returned restrictions or conditional access. A fixed 2050 m ceiling is scoped to this independently evidenced chain; general detour limits are unchanged. Both original cantonal and pfaedle failures remain retained. Inferred centreline geometry, not operator-certified running lanes or temporary access.
